name: Althouse College and Wampum Learning Lodge
summary: Low stone classroom wings surround a rectangular garden court. Deep concrete fins frame the windows. A round two-level lodge with a projecting silver dome anchors the northeast corner.

evidence.note: The oblique east view shows repeated projecting blades, two tiers of recessed glass, and solid end walls.
The old round library has a deep eave, recessed upper glazing, and a continuous projecting balcony edge.
The university oblique photograph shows the separate low wings, courtyard, and circular library. Pale stone and concrete were sampled from the classroom elevation.
The post-renovation exterior shows the silver roof, new glazing, and timber gathering shelter beside the lodge.
The 2025 orthophoto shows the open garden court, roof seams, exterior circular lodge, and small round central skylight.
Inventory P50 / P90 / maximum: 8.05 / 9.5 / 13.6 m above local ground.

notes: The timber lattice gathering shelter stands separately east of the lodge. The balcony wraps around the circular upper floor. The inventory omits the main open-air courtyard, which the massing clips preserve.

parts.name: Neck between lodge and teaching range
